objective: Preserve digital scope and release boundaries
method: Inspect specification; artifact status; spinal-only versus hybrid labels; synced-source handling; historical release boundaries; and attribution
pass_criterion: Digital scope; source read-only policy; preserved historical release; AI and AstroSam contribution credit; and explicit hybrid labels agree across the dossier; no full implant or biological validation is claimed
limitation: This row defines an audit; no new experiment or implementation is reported

objective: Trace both ambitions through the complete mechanism
method: Inspect motor and target-specific physiological causal diagrams and interface ownership
pass_criterion: Every required chain contains observations; interpretation; personalized or target-specific intervention; measured electrical delivery; uncertain response; and feedback with named owners
limitation: Diagram completeness does not establish that the biological links work

objective: Restrict online software to available information
method: Enumerate simulator truth; evaluator truth; training labels; decoder inputs; calibration observations; and controller payloads
pass_criterion: No true phase; hidden learner skill; recruitment coefficient; future sample; or held-out outcome is available to online software except a labeled oracle condition

objective: Separate evidence types and parameter provenance
method: Cross-reference model assumptions; evidence register; units; and values requiring primary-source investigation
pass_criterion: Every biological link and provisional range is classified as published evidence; hypothesis; idealization; requirement; or digitally verified quantity with unresolved values identified
limitation: This specification does not itself validate or source every provisional numerical range

objective: Define comparisons capable of isolating information value
method: Review sensing-by-policy factorial and expert trajectory-only control
pass_criterion: External-only and spinal-plus-external conditions cross expert-informed and learner-only policies; expert neural content has a trajectory-only comparator; null and harmful outcomes remain allowed
limitation: Fair implemented comparisons and their outcomes remain future work

objective: Define fair learner and evaluation budgets
method: Audit proposed practice; calibration; expert-resource; tuning; and evaluation budgets
pass_criterion: Paired conditions share declared learner exposure; calibration effort; external sensors; disturbances; actuator constraints; and evaluation protocol; offline expert cost is disclosed separately
limitation: Equal information availability is a design rule; it does not guarantee equivalent computation or biological burden

objective: Separate contact and channel quantities
method: Audit proposed channel inventory and routing terminology
pass_criterion: Recording contacts; digitized channels; independent output drivers; and simultaneous stimulation configurations are separately counted and connected to module responsibilities
limitation: Final counts follow later observability; routing; timing; power; and mechanical budgets

objective: Define later checks without claiming execution
method: Inspect every verification row and claim-to-evidence mapping
pass_criterion: Each row states an objective; method; pass criterion; evidence type; stage; and limitation; future checks are not reported as passed
limitation: A completed matrix is not completed verification

objective: Keep application and placement selection reviewable
method: Compare candidate motor task families; physiological behaviors; external sensors; and placement alternatives
pass_criterion: A reasoned recommendation and tradeoffs are prepared for the Stage 1 checkpoint; no old rhythmic task; contact count; or desktop dimensions are silently imposed
limitation: Selection requires the project checkpoint and may change later budgets

objective: Separate online assistance from retained learning claims
method: Audit proposed outcome definitions and adaptation assumptions
pass_criterion: Active assistance; assistance-free retention; and held-out transfer have distinct trials and metrics; no fixed acquisition multiplier is an acceptance requirement
limitation: Synthetic adaptation is not evidence of retained human learning

objective: Generate electrode observations through a declared forward model
method: Implement source populations; geometry-dependent transfer; noise; drift; common mode; and artifact sources with unit tests
pass_criterion: Decoder input is contact voltage after the declared acquisition path; source and transfer units close; no direct true-phase bypass supplies the normal controller
limitation: Planned; source populations and lead fields remain approximations rather than demonstrated human recordings

objective: Prevent training and temporal information leakage
method: Audit grouped training splits; feature windows; timestamps; expert freezing; and held-out contexts
pass_criterion: Online features use only causally available samples; repeated windows from held-out performances do not leak into training; expert pipeline is frozen before learner evaluation
limitation: Planned; a valid synthetic split does not establish generalization to real people

objective: Expose observation identifiability failures
method: Construct distinct latent states with similar contact observations and reduced or redundant source information
pass_criterion: Ambiguity is quantified; confidence or abstention reflects the declared criterion; failed discrimination is reported rather than repaired with hidden truth
limitation: Planned; the set of constructed ambiguous states is not an exhaustive biological identifiability proof

objective: Learn expert content rather than replay expert voltage
method: Train the declared task-conditioned representation from expert observations and reference measurements
pass_criterion: Representation generation is reproducible; includes multiple declared expert performances; maps into learner coordinates; and has no direct electrode-voltage replay equivalence claim
limitation: Planned; synthetic experts do not supply evidence that recorded human spinal features encode expertise

objective: Identify learner response from calibration observations
method: Fit recruitment or local response models to bounded calibration inputs and measured delivery; evaluate held-out inputs and contexts
pass_criterion: Parameter uncertainty and validity region are retained; held-out prediction is scored against preregistered Stage 2 criteria; unidentifiable or wrong-sign responses cause defined fallback or reported failure
limitation: Planned; response-model validity and acceptable prediction tolerances remain target-specific decisions

objective: Measure incremental spinal and expert information value
method: Run paired sensing-by-policy factorial plus expert trajectory-only comparator using matched budgets
pass_criterion: All primary contrasts and raw outcomes are reported including equality or deterioration; sensor timing and resource differences are disclosed; no superior result is required
limitation: Planned; favorable modeled information structure is not evidence of actual spinal access

objective: Test content and mapping negative controls
method: Shuffle neural or expert associations; remove neural input; perturb expert context; and corrupt learner mapping
pass_criterion: Comparisons expose sensitivity to relevant information and incorrect mappings; controls have equivalent declared information and exposure budgets
limitation: Planned; a shuffle can detect one dependency but cannot alone establish causal biological transfer

objective: Permit favorable; zero; and harmful adaptation
method: Evaluate specified adaptation families with zero coupling; dependent learning; and detrimental intervention effects
pass_criterion: Parameters are declared before comparisons; zero and harmful outcomes are preserved; no desired speedup is inserted and then treated as discovery
limitation: Planned; all artificial adaptation laws remain unvalidated models of biological learning

objective: Measure unassisted retention and transfer separately
method: Disable assistance for probe trials and test held-out contexts with declared state reset; washout; and forgetting assumptions
pass_criterion: Outcome scoring uses observed task performance; active-assistance metrics are separate; threshold censoring and any elapsed-time assumptions are reported
limitation: Planned; simulated retention intervals do not validate sleep consolidation or real elapsed-time learning

objective: Challenge decoding and control under realistic interface defects
method: Sweep noise; geometry mismatch; drift; artifact recovery; unknown delay; saturation; sensor faults; and lost samples
pass_criterion: Error; confidence; command activity; and failure transitions are reported over the declared envelope; unavailable observations are not silently replaced with truth
limitation: Planned; selected sweeps are not an exhaustive operating or safety envelope

objective: Expose insufficient authority and sensory costs
method: Construct unreachable task states; weak recruitment; cross-coupling; sensory-feedback disruption; and adverse response directions
pass_criterion: The controller stays within the declared electrical contract and reports infeasibility; sensory cost; or target failure; authority is not increased silently to obtain success
limitation: Planned; modeled failure handling is not a safe clinical fallback and sensory-interference parameters remain uncertain

objective: Use target-specific physiological dynamics and external sensing
method: After target selection connect measured delivery to uncertain recruitment; physiological response; and delayed biased external observation
pass_criterion: The model names one output and requested behavior; unknown response parameters are estimated or bounded; physiological feedback is not assumed readable from spinal voltage
limitation: Planned; no human dose-response or clinical target is established

objective: Determine whether physiological spinal recording adds value
method: Compare identical external-sensor feedback policies with and without the proposed additional spinal observable
pass_criterion: Added information and its availability are defined; sustained and transient metrics are reported; no advantage is an acceptable result and the external-feedback stimulation architecture remains explicit
limitation: Planned; a recording benefit in a synthetic plant depends on its assumed observation mechanism

objective: Account for physiological failure and termination
method: Challenge disturbance rejection; output limits; sensor bias and dropout; adverse coupling; and requested stop or mode transition
pass_criterion: Sustained regulation and transient dips; overshoot; response onset; termination; effort; and loss of support are separately reported; inhibition is not labeled universally safe
limitation: Planned; clinical harm and acceptable fallback behavior require evidence outside this digital project

objective: Close signal and conversion budgets
method: Calculate source range; electrode impedance; AFE noise; headroom; filtering; ADC resolution; sampling; and saturation margins
pass_criterion: Budget values have units and provenance; selected nominal and uncertainty cases meet declared margins or trigger a documented architecture change
limitation: Planned; numerical acceptance thresholds require target-specific evidence and are not supplied here

objective: Close causal timing and synchronization budgets
method: Analyze clocks; group delay; conversion; buffering; processing; telemetry; scheduling; jitter; and artifact recovery
pass_criterion: End-to-end latency and clock uncertainty fit the declared control requirement or a specified redesign; future data and zero-cost communication are absent
limitation: Planned; real MCU scheduling and clock performance remain unmeasured

objective: Close power; heat; charge; and compliance budgets
method: Compute operating modes and worst declared load; energy; driver; monitor; reference; telemetry; and package cases
pass_criterion: Power and delivery budgets include margins and failure cases; commanded and delivered current are distinct; no implicit free energy or universal analog cap is assumed
limitation: Planned; a closed digital budget is not thermal; tissue; or hardware qualification

objective: Bound uncertain response and control authority
method: Analyze identified parameter uncertainty and achievable target region under selected electrical limits
pass_criterion: Authority and uncertainty envelopes are declared; unreachable targets and invalid response regions have specified outcomes; controller gains are not justified by a favorable plant alone
limitation: Planned; selected reduced-order dynamics may omit adverse biological mechanisms

objective: Integrate acquisition and ADC with actual decoder input
method: Run contact voltages through the selected digital circuit and sampling models and inspect sample frames
pass_criterion: Decoder sees filtered; quantized; timestamped values with validity flags; clipping and recovery alter the input rather than bypassing it
limitation: Planned; device-specific models remain conditional and no implanted recording is demonstrated

objective: Verify multichannel sampling and stimulation routing
method: Exercise channel count; skew; multiplex settling; buffering; simultaneous routes; and invalid route requests
pass_criterion: Observed timing and routing meet the versioned contract or produce a defined fault; channel identities do not change silently across modules
limitation: Planned; this does not demonstrate chronic electrode independence or neural selectivity

objective: Measure delivered charge under electrical uncertainty
method: Integrate modeled monitor current through electrode-load; compliance; mismatch; stored-polarization; and timing cases
pass_criterion: Reported phase and net charge derive from modeled measured delivery rather than symmetric commands; uncertainty and violated limits are exposed
limitation: Planned; circuit-model charge is not measured hardware or tissue safety evidence

objective: Connect stimulation artifacts to acquisition validity
method: Drive artifact generation from actual modeled electrical delivery and route changes and test recovery
pass_criterion: Invalid samples and recovery intervals enter the decoder quality contract; control uses no artifact-contaminated samples outside its declared policy
limitation: Planned; artifact kernels and settling may differ substantially from a real implant

objective: Verify independent current; voltage; and compliance monitoring
method: Inject delivery deviations while holding commanded values fixed and model sensor error and latency
pass_criterion: The monitor detects deviations according to declared thresholds or reports blind regions; it does not infer delivery merely from the command
limitation: Planned; monitoring independence and diagnostic coverage require hardware validation later

objective: Exercise fault supervision and command admission
method: Inject stale or ambiguous state; lost radio; replayed or unauthorized messages; version-mismatched configuration; conflicting applications; reset; brownout; stuck monitor; main-clock failure; and independent supervisory faults
pass_criterion: Local admission rejects invalid or unauthorized plans and configurations; application resource conflicts follow declared arbitration; independent detection and output response are measured; uncertain delivery and application-specific loss-of-support effects remain recorded
limitation: Planned; specified inhibition may itself cause lost physiological support and is not universally safe

objective: Account for interrupted and distorted balancing phases
method: Interrupt power or timer action during a phase and apply compliance or current errors
pass_criterion: Delivered charge imbalance is recorded; recovery or shutdown behavior is explicitly bounded; ideal completion on a software fault is not extended to a power-loss guarantee
limitation: Planned; a digital fallback does not establish electrochemical recovery or safe human interruption

objective: Check supply and programmable-driver dependence
method: Sweep supply; reference; temperature-model parameters; configuration; current range; and electrode load
pass_criterion: Driver behavior and compliance are evaluated against the declared contract; actual achievable settings and current uncertainty are recorded
limitation: Planned; vendor and parasitic models may omit real worst cases

objective: Verify native electronics completeness and consistency
method: Audit complete block schematic; native netlists; BOM; selected pinouts; logic levels; ERC; DRC; and schematic parity
pass_criterion: Required acquisition; conversion; processing; stimulation; monitoring; power; communication; and supervision functions are represented; source and exports agree
limitation: Planned; clean design rules do not prove signal integrity; analog stability; manufacturing yield; or biological effectiveness

objective: Derive contact and lead geometry from mechanism
method: Map target structures; placement alternative; source transfer; recruitment assumptions; and contact rationale to parameterized geometry
pass_criterion: Contact geometry and count have a stated rationale and uncertainty; different recording and stimulation placements are not conflated
limitation: Planned; anatomical fit and tissue compatibility are not established by a CAD model

objective: Match physical contacts to electrical channels and routing
method: Cross-check contact; feedthrough; connector; harness; driver; and sampled-channel identities
pass_criterion: A complete physical-to-electrical map exists and agrees with model and netlist identities; scaling adds its routing and resource costs
limitation: Planned; connection consistency does not demonstrate usable neural signals or selective recruitment

objective: Fit selected components and interfaces in nominal assemblies
method: Import populated native boards; selected connectors; cable and feedthrough envelopes; and mounting geometry
pass_criterion: No prohibited nominal interference remains; connector access; bend and strain-relief allowances are declared; generic holes are not called verified connector fits
limitation: Planned; tolerances and physical assembly are not measured in an entirely digital project

objective: Separate implant anatomy from desktop/test equivalents
method: Audit assemblies; drawings; coordinate systems; material assumptions; and purpose labels
pass_criterion: Future implant; lead; companion; and test-equivalent geometries are distinctly identified; no desktop shell is relabeled as an implant package
limitation: Planned; hermeticity; sterilization; chronic durability; and surgical feasibility need evidence beyond geometry

objective: Connect package geometry to power and uncertainty budgets
method: Review thermal/energy analysis; material assumptions; anatomical reference variation; tolerances; and package envelopes
pass_criterion: Mechanical choices are compatible with the declared budget and uncertainty cases or trigger a coordinated electronics/mechanical revision
limitation: Planned; no tissue-temperature or implant reliability guarantee follows from the selected reduced-order analysis

objective: Trace the complete digital feedback loop
method: Replay generated sources through electrodes; AFE/ADC; embedded control; driver; measured current; recruitment; body response; and feedback on the declared clock
pass_criterion: A trace links each interface and observed outcome for both selected applications; units; IDs; timing; quality; and faults agree without a hidden ideal bypass
limitation: Planned; full digital integration still does not prove the biological assumptions

objective: Reproduce data and validity bookkeeping
method: Reproduce seeded studies and firmware traces from a clean checkout; inspect source/model/data versions and configuration/calibration/model activation logs and validity consistency
pass_criterion: Raw results and metadata reproduce within declared tolerances; seeds and versions are preserved; every session and admitted output traces to the activated valid configuration calibration and model; incompatible or stale versions cannot silently activate
limitation: Planned; more repeatable synthetic data do not reduce unmodeled biological uncertainty

objective: Audit every final claim against the appropriate evidence
method: Map manuscript and repository claims to requirements; assumptions; tests; sources; and unresolved links
pass_criterion: No circuit; CAD; decoder; or synthetic-learning result is promoted into an unsupported human efficacy; implantation; or safety claim
limitation: Planned; external evidence must be interpreted within its own placement; population; and study limits

objective: Report negative outcomes and architecture revisions honestly
method: Review preregistered metrics; failures; censored thresholds; revisions; and uncertainty sensitivity
pass_criterion: Null; harmful; unreachable; and failed comparisons are retained; revisions disclose changed assumptions; a positive effect is not required for a complete digital investigation
limitation: Planned; a negative synthetic outcome also does not prove biological impossibility

objective: Establish usable spinal observations in the intended setting
method: Evaluate independent experimental recordings and prospective validation against the chosen placement and task
pass_criterion: Evidence establishes which target states are observable under declared context; artifact; and held-out conditions before a real biological decoding claim is made
limitation: Not performed or required to be generated by this entirely digital project; current synthetic sources cannot pass this check

objective: Establish learner or physiological recruitment and causal influence
method: Evaluate controlled experiments relating measured delivery and anatomical route to response and adverse/off-target effects
pass_criterion: Experimental evidence supports the claimed response and validity region before model recruitment is treated as established biology
limitation: Not performed here; a plausible mechanism or fitted synthetic map cannot establish this causal link

objective: Establish retained skill and transfer rather than assistance only
method: Specify and eventually evaluate controlled assisted-practice; unassisted-retention; and transfer comparisons with appropriate review
pass_criterion: Actual outcomes distinguish immediate assistance from retained causal learning and account for baseline practice and expert information before a human acceleration claim
limitation: No participant or animal experiments are authorized or reported; no fixed acquisition multiplier is presumed

objective: Establish chronic interface and implanted-system suitability
method: Evaluate appropriate physical; electrochemical; biocompatibility; reliability; and chronic experimental evidence
pass_criterion: Claims of chronic recording; tissue compatibility; sealing; implanted reliability; and safety have evidence specific to the proposed system
